input: Research LASIK surgery consultation options nearby

gold.taskTitle: Research Nearby LASIK Surgery Consultation Options
gold.taskDescription: Find and evaluate local LASIK surgery consultation options to determine the best fit for the user's vision correction needs.

questions.title: What city or neighborhood should the search focus on?
questions.description: Identify the specific geographic area to narrow down nearby LASIK providers.

questions.title: Have you had an eye exam or prescription updated recently?
questions.description: Determine whether the user has a current prescription or needs one before a LASIK consultation.

questions.title: Do you have a specific budget range in mind for LASIK?
questions.description: Understand financial constraints to filter out consultations or clinics outside the user's price range.

questions.title: Are you looking for free consultations or paid specialist evaluations?
questions.description: Clarify what type of consultation the user expects, as some clinics offer free screenings while others charge.

questions.title: Do you have a preferred timeline for booking the consultation?
questions.description: Establish urgency so the plan can prioritize availability and scheduling steps accordingly.

questions.title: Are there specific vision conditions driving your interest in LASIK?
questions.description: Understand the user's eye condition (myopia, astigmatism, etc.) to identify clinics with relevant expertise.

questions.title: Do you want to compare multiple clinics or focus on one top choice?
questions.description: Determine the scope of research — whether to build a shortlist for comparison or target a single highly-rated provider.
